answer: Locks are written down in whisper, expire in glacier, and kernel lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 124 aliases as a result needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 48 aliases cost 226 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
